title: OPS-42: preserve retry attempt counter across circuit breaker half-open
author: Dana Whitfield
description: The attempt counter was stored on the circuit breaker rather than the delivery record, so a half-open transition reset it. Moves the counter to the delivery aggregate and adds a regression test covering provider degradation.

title: OPS-42: add integration test for exhausted webhook retries
author: Tomás Herrera
description: Adds a WireMock-backed test that degrades the provider for 90 seconds and asserts all 8 attempts are made.

title: PLAT-23: subscription-tier throttling for internal consumers
author: Kenji Watanabe
description: Applies per-subscription rate limits at the gateway and moves the two batch consumers onto a dedicated tier.

title: PLAT-31: require Idempotency-Key on mutating endpoints
author: Tomás Herrera
description: Adds an idempotency filter with a 24-hour Redis-backed replay window. Returns 409 on a key reuse with a different body hash.

title: PLAT-39: emit structured policy decision records
author: Kenji Watanabe
description: Every allow/deny at the gateway now emits a JSON record naming principal, resource and the rule that fired. Closes the gap where transport-level analytics could not attribute a decision to a specific tool.

title: WEB-7: restore checkout form state on history navigation
author: Marta Nowak
description: Persists the checkout form to session storage on every step transition and rehydrates on mount.

title: WEB-14: inline critical CSS and defer analytics bundle
author: Marta Nowak
description: Brings FCP from 3.1s to 1.6s on the throttled 4G profile. Font subsetting accounts for most of the gain.

title: WEB-22: warn before session expiry and offer silent refresh
author: Tomás Herrera
description: Shows a dismissible warning at two minutes remaining, with a refresh that preserves unsaved form state.

title: WEB-11: raise dark-theme contrast at the token level
author: Marta Nowak
description: Declined in favour of a broader token restructure tracked separately — the per-surface overrides here would have to be unwound.

title: OPS-64: serialise staging applies with a pipeline concurrency group
author: Aisha Bello
description: Adds a concurrency group per workspace so only one apply runs at a time, plus a lock-age check that fails fast rather than hanging.

title: OPS-51: move internal gateway certificates to cert-manager
author: Aisha Bello
description: Replaces four manually issued certificates with cert-manager Certificate resources and automated renewal at 30 days remaining.

title: WEB-19: bump design-tokens to 4.2.0
author: Priya Raghunathan
description: Closes the four-release gap behind web-frontend. Spacing scale changes will need a visual review pass.
